title: Session placement and Message Tools composer review
scope: Fork/Resume new-tab placement and adaptive Message Tools input

evidence.observation: A forked Agent resumed in a new tab and the new surface appeared to the right of the pre-fork Agent.
evidence.risk: Ambient focus or a stale Region is being used instead of the target Session's durable Tab/Region owner.

evidence.source: a mature workbench workspace tab model
evidence.observation: A workspace tab belongs to a concrete worktree/session context; active focus does not redefine that ownership.
Message Tools should use a flexible central editor with stable side controls.

decision.sessionPlacement: Resolve all fork/resume/browser/new-tab destinations from the target Session's owning Workspace, Tab, Region and insertion policy; ambient focus is never a fallback placement.
decision.composer: Use an elastic left-aligned editor that grows from one line to a bounded multiline surface before scrolling.

acceptance: A forked Session resumed from its own context opens its new Tab in that Session's intended work surface, regardless of the currently focused Agent.
A target that cannot be resolved stays visible as a recoverable placement error instead of attaching to another Agent.
Message Tools input expands when content exceeds one line and preserves stable side controls and left-aligned reading.
